=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, Lines 624-632 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: After `gate_twin_sync_exempt` denies the exemption, the gate still skips review for a sync-named head whose API-fetched title or body contains `[skip ai]`.
  WHY: On `workflow_dispatch`, an unverified fork, consumer-repository, or other-author PR can include the marker and trigger `SHOULD_RUN=false`, bypassing the review the provenance check was meant to require.
- docs/implement-plan/issue-5610-limit-twin-sync-review-skip.md, Line 41 (second bullet under `## Lessons`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The lesson says the fallback only works on `pull_request` runs, but the round 1 fix reads cached PR text for twin-sync heads on dispatch.
  WHY: On merge, `scripts/ingest_implement_plan_lessons.py` ingests `## Lessons` into AI memory, where future runs can retrieve an incorrect soft prior that contradicts the implemented behavior.
- Requirement: "Limit the exemption to this repository and verify same-repository head provenance and the sync workflow's bot identity; review every other matching PR normally." (issue #5610)
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` lines 624-632 — the new `elif` branch that reads cached PR text for `claude/claude-twin-sync-*` heads after provenance denial
  Evidence of absence: The new fallback branch at lines 624-632 checks only `pr_head_ref == claude/claude-twin-sync-*` and the cached PR text for `[skip ai]`, without re-verifying provenance. An unverified PR (fork, consumer, wrong author) that includes `[skip ai]` in its body still sets `SHOULD_RUN=false` and skips review. The provenance check at lines 541-600 correctly denies the exemption, but the fallback undoes that denial. The test `test_gate_twin_sync_skip_marker_is_read_from_the_fetched_pr_on_dispatch` asserts this bypass as correct behavior. The fix should either restrict the cached-text fallback to provenance-verified sync PRs only (e.g., skip it when `gate_twin_sync_exempt` denied with a reason other than `sync_identity_unavailable`), or remove it entirely and accept that a genuine sync PR whose identity cannot be read will be reviewed.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
